description: Daily returns to today only after sending in an older conversation. The page runs in New York with its clock fixed at 2026-10-08T16:00:00Z. The test lists exactly two conversations: {{OLDER}} (slug {{OLDER_SLUG}}), updated the day before, and {{TODAY}} (slug {{TODAY_SLUG}}), updated at that moment. The live update stream is held until call "release-list", after which it reports both as updated at that moment. The test fails the first message sent to {{OLDER}} with a 500 "daily send failed" and passes the rest to the server; call "chat-statuses" lists how each message sent to {{OLDER}} was answered: "500" for that failure, "ok" for a 2xx, else the status. "The picker" is data-testid "conversation-day-filter"; "the date" is its ".drawer-day-date" and "the count" its ".drawer-day-count". The picker's buttons "Previous day", "Next day", "Today" and "Turn off Daily" are {"selector": "[data-testid='conversation-day-filter']", "role": "button", "name": "...", "exact": true}. To "group by L": click the button "View options", then click {"selector": ".group-by-menu", "role": "button", "name": "L", "exact": true}. Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"). Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /c/{{TODAY_SLUG}}. 2. Click the button "Open conversations". 3. Group by Daily. 4. Click the picker's button "Previous day". 5. The date reads exactly "Yesterday". 6. Click the ".conversation-title" inside the row of {{OLDER}}. 7. The URL is exactly /c/{{OLDER_SLUG}} (assert_url value). 8. Click the button "Open conversations". 9. The date reads exactly "Yesterday", and the row of {{OLDER}} is visible. 10. Click the button "Close conversations". 11. Fill data-testid "message-input" with "Hello". 12. Click data-testid "send-button". 13. Call "chat-statuses" with expect '["500"]'. 14. The message input's value is still exactly "Hello" (assert_value). 15. Click the button "Open conversations". 16. The date reads exactly "Yesterday", and the row of {{OLDER}} is visible. 17. Click the button "Close conversations". 18. Click data-testid "send-button". 19. Call "chat-statuses" with expect '["500","ok"]'. 20. Click the button "Open conversations". 21. The date reads exactly "Today" and the count exactly "1". 22. The row of {{OLDER}} is not visible (assert_not_visible). 23. Call "release-list". 24. The row of {{OLDER}} is visible, and it has the class active. 25. The count reads exactly "2".
